text:
maya: kicking off RC for urgent search hotfix — candidate rc-search-511 created, pin=3f8a2b9c
alex: saw deploy-bot. what artifact sha?
maya: confirmed sha: 3f8a2b9c (main + cherrypick)
kat: infra check: no infra diffs, just ranking config + model selector bump
deploy-bot: Candidate rc-search-511 created by maya at 6205550000. pin=3f8a2b9c. requested window: now -> +30m
sam: oncall here. are we doing staged canary?
maya: plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~20m with telemetry gates and KV-warm step at 2%
alex: share rollback commands pls
maya: rollback plan (quick):
```
# rollback to previous model pin
redwood deploy set-pin --route /search --model pin:prev-2026-03-21
redwood traffic shift --route /search --to default --percent 100
```
kat: infra escape hatch if autoscaler misbehaves: `kubectl scale deployment search-api --replicas=3`
smoke-bot: queued smoke suite (search-basic, search-latency). results in ~90s
maya: manual pre-smoke checks: no DB migrations, config diff clean
sam: requesting sheriff ack for a 15m radio-silence during promo
alex: ack from me for radio silence + on-call monitor on traces
deploy-bot: Scheduling canary: 2% for 3m, 10% for 7m, 50% for 10m. KV warm hook at 2%
maya: starting canary now, tagging release note: "fix: search ranking regression in multi-token queries"
kat: watch redis miss rate during KV warm. alert if >80% miss for 1m
smoke-bot: smoke results: search-basic OK, latency within baseline p95 +5%
alex: add tracing for /search/stream and /search/aggregate endpoints
maya: 2% -> warming KV, expect small p95 spike
sam: if metrics are good i'll greenlight 10% step; otherwise we'll keep low traffic and roll artifact back to be safe
alex: sheriff standing by. rollback trigger: errors >1% sustained for 5m
maya: 10% hold — metrics look normal :thumbsup:
smoke-bot: canary transition logged (2% -> 10%) at 6205550988
maya: planning 50% lift in ~5m once 10% stable
deploy-bot: promo checklist: artifact pinned, smoke green, sheriff ack, window set, rollback cmd saved, release note updated
sam: documenting release note in repo under releases/rc-search-511.md
alex: post-promo eval: run quick ranking eval against canary promptset to verify no regressions
maya: will run eval after 50% lift; if ranking regresses we'll rollforward to previous pin and throttle traffic
kat: leaving monitoring hooks for 30m post-promo; i'll escalate on infra pressure
maya: calling radio-silence for 15m starting now :rotating_light:
alex: ack
sam: greenlighted, proceeding with promotion window
deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% initiated at 6205550200. auto-advance if gates pass
